content: Pablo, Cristo-igargi alamaknaid
Deginbali, gwenadgan, Bab-Jesúsʼgi wergumarsun. Angardi an gannar-gannar bemarga ibmar-narmakedi gwen akar an itosulid. Ar an gannar-gannar narmakedi, bemarga ibnued gued.
Dulemar-achuyob-damaladgi nue-salakarmar. We-dulemar-ibmar-isgana-imakmaladgi nue-salakarmar. We-dulemar Bab-Jesúsʼba-naiguega abgan-uka-duku-sikergebye-sogmaladgi, nue-salakarmar.
Ar anmardi burbar bur abgan-uka-duku-sikarmaladid.

content.text: Ar ade, anmar Bab-Dummad-Burbaba Bab-Dummad-nug odummodimalad,

content: Ar an dulemar-ibmar-imakedgi-bensurguega ibmar-soged sunna an sogmogad. Ar dule-baid dule-ibmar-imakedgi bensurye-sogele, andi bur bule a-duleba we-ibmar-soged nikad:

content.text: Ar an gwalulesgu, ibabaabakgi (8) an-abgan-e-uka-duku siklesad.
Ar an, igar-baidba dulemar-nanabisur-abeged-ular, an Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-baregindii gusad.
An Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba nue-nanadigussoggu, dule geg annik-soged, an a-Igar-Maidba ibsassurye.

content: Degi-inigwele, iduar we-ibmarmar bela anga ibnueganbi an dakdigusanad. Emidi, an Cristo-sabed-ular, bela we-ibmarmar, ibmar-isganayob an daknonikid.

Ar napiragwad, an-Dummad-Cristo-Jesús an bur bela-bela-wisgubied-ular, we-ibmarmar an indaksad. Ar an Cristo-sabed-ular, bela we-ibmarmar, ibmar-isganayob an daked. Degi, an Cristo-nue-baramiega we-ibmar binsa-ibmar-isgana-milegedyob an daked.

Deginbali, Bab-Dummad Cristoʼgi-nue-akanai an-dakbaligar. Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba an-isgussuliyob-dakleye-sogleged an abesulid. Ar unnila Cristoʼgi-bensur-gunonikidba isgussuliyob-dakleged an abeged. Dule-isgussuliyob-dakleged Bab-Dummadgi danikid. We-igar, dule Cristoʼgi-bensuliguedba nikued.
An bela nue-Cristo-wisgubied-ular, bela ibmarmar-an-imaksad an meted. Unnila na e-gannar-durgusadgi gangued-oyolesadi an nue itobied. E-wilesadgi an wilebied, degi, e-burgwisadgii an burgwebimogad.
Deyobi, an dulemar-burgwismalad-abargi, an gannar-durgumogad abitoged.
Amba anmar alamaknaid
Ar we soglesulid, bato an bela ibmar amisye, igidibe, bato an dule-innikigwadye. Degi-inigwele, amba an alamaknaimogad, adi, an baramiega, ar Cristo-Jesús ibiga-an-susmoga.
Gwenadgan, an-sunnad, we-ibmar bato an bela baramisdeeye an sogsulid. Unnila ibmar-soggwen an imaked, ibmar-nasmalad ies-imaked. Emigindi, an unnila ibmar-danimaladginbi alamaknaisunnad.
Degisoggu, amba an alamaknaid, adi, Bab-Dummad Jesucristoʼba-anse-gochadba nibneggi-ibmar-nued-ukoed an nikuegar.
Degisoggu, bela anmar Jesucristoʼgi-ulubgi-bensulidgi-nasgumamaid, anmar weyob binsaewilubmalad. Ar bemar we-ibmargi akar binsadibe, Bab-Dummad magar-ito be-imakmarbaloed.
Degisoggu, anmar bato Cristo-igar-durdaksadba nanadii gumarsun.
Gwenadgan, an-daedba be damar. Ar igi-an-daed an bemarga oyodigusa, ayob gwenadgan-nanadimaladba be damarmosun.
Bato an bukidargus bemarga sogdanikid, emidi, an boed-abalagi, an gannar bemarga sogbalid, ar bukidar Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisad-e-isdarmaladyob gudidimalad.

Amargardi, bergued-igar maid. Ar na e-saban e-bab-dummadga imakdimalad. E-ibmar-imakdiidgi san-dummarbaa itodimalad. Ar a-ibmar-imakedgi bur binge itowilubmalanad. Unnila we-napneggi-ibmar-nikadginbi binsamalad.
Ar anmardi nibneggined gumalad. Ar anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo anmar-Abonoged, a-nibneg-akar-danikoed, anmar edarbebuksunnad.
Jesucristo gangued-nikadba belagwapa ibmar ganikid. A-gangued-nikadba, Jesucristo anmar-san-napaga-guoed, e-san-nibneggined-nikadyob anmarga ogwanonikoed.
